Oil bears are making the same mistake oil bulls made in May. 

In May, a lot of us kept asking, why was the physical oil market weakening even though transits were low? And then it turned out that the shuttle trade was secretly underway. 

Now that everyone knows about the shuttle trade and the returning volume, people aren’t asking, why is the physical market so tight?

It’s the same but inverse.
